independence_declaration.statement: I (domain-reviewer) authored none of the reviewed scope: the sources' extraction, the analysis artefacts, the register, the gate tooling (incl. the D-041 change) and decisions.md were written by transformation-analyst and delivery-orchestrator. I formed this verdict before reading any other round-25 review record (none were visible to me during this run).

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate and a complete clone. In the main repository, record HEAD and shallow status and recompute the candidate ID. Then make a fresh `git clone --no-local`, check out 2386a0f there, recompute the ID, and list which candidate-scope files changed since the round-24 baseline 6db3b83 and which files the post-freeze commit touched.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git clone -q --no-local /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/review-dom25 && git checkout 2386a0f && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git diff --name-only 6db3b83 HEAD (excluding D-005 metadata); git diff --name-only 2386a0f e84c393
checks_run.environment: Main repository (HEAD e84c393) and a fresh --no-local clone at 2386a0f in $TMPDIR; node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: Both compute sha256:b77a1c63…cbab; shallow=false; post-freeze commit touches only excluded metadata
checks_run.actual: Main HEAD is e84c393 ('freeze round-25 candidate …'), shallow=false. Both the main tree and the clone compute sha256:b77a1c6303fe7be11fbdc858c2810329e947871d788d29b8f000cbd6dbfdcbab (91 files). The candidate-scope changes since 6db3b83 are exactly tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs, tools/gates/tests/validator.test.mjs and docs/delivery/decisions.md. e84c393 touches only assignments/round-25, the candidate manifest and stages.json, all excluded by D-005.

checks_run.procedure:
Independent extraction check. Verify the docx SHA-256, unzip it, and strip the XML tags from word/document.xml paragraph by paragraph (NFKC, quote-normalised, whitespace-insensitive). Check that every non-empty paragraph occurs in playbook.md (anchors and
removed), count the tables and rows, and compare the footer1.xml text. Then run the repository's reproducibility check.
checks_run.command: sha256sum docs/source/Business_Transformation_Playbook.docx; unzip; python3 ext.py word/document.xml docs/source/playbook.md; bash tools/source/check_extraction.sh
checks_run.expected: SHA-256 2584a352…548ad2; 0 docx paragraphs missing from playbook.md; footer recorded; check_extraction PASS
checks_run.actual:
SHA-256 2584a35282804e639a697478eae75a55a43cfb8c551345dfc7636b9b34548ad2. Of 1001 text paragraphs (24,939 chars, 49 tables, 239 rows), 0 are missing. A first pass flagged 14 multi-run table cells because my matcher left the markdown
in place; all 14 were confirmed present at playbook.md lines 14, 295-300 and 721, and a
-aware rerun gives 0. The footer 'BUSINESS TRANSFORMATION PLAYBOOK | PRACTICAL EDITION' is recorded in a header comment. Anchors B0001-B0165 are all present (165 unique). check_extraction.sh: PASS (165 playbook blocks; 423 master-prompt blocks).

checks_run.procedure: Parse source-coverage.csv. Check that it lists exactly B0001-B0165 in order, that every REQUIREMENT block has at least one requirement ID, and that no requirement ID dangles. Check bidirectionally that each requirement mapped from a REQUIREMENT block cites that block, including B-ranges, in its source_ref. Read every CONTEXT and NON-REQUIREMENT disposition against the block text, looking for dropped substance.
checks_run.command: python3 (inline) over docs/analysis/source-coverage.csv, docs/delivery/requirements.csv and docs/source/playbook.blocks.json
checks_run.expected: 165 rows in order; 0 dangling or missing; 0 back-reference gaps; non-requirement rows have no methodology substance
checks_run.actual: 165 rows, exactly B0001-B0165 (REQUIREMENT 129, CONTEXT 29, NON-REQUIREMENT 7); 0 dangling or missing mappings; 0 back-reference gaps. The 36 non-requirement rows are cover, version, headings, phase and TEMPLATE labels, the reference-URL list and the 'how to extend (Excel/PowerPoint)' note. Each rationale names where the substance lives (e.g. B0003 → REQ-PB-014; B0005 → master prompt §6 versioning). No column, value list, rule, band or question is dropped.

checks_run.procedure: Parse every 'Template N' header row (T01-T16) and the 14 charter fields from playbook.md, and check each column verbatim (case- and dash-normalised) in requirements.csv and field-inventory.md. Check the source value lists in both files. For items not verbatim in the register, read the owning row and the field-inventory section.
checks_run.command: python3 tmpl.py; grep for paraphrased values; python3 dump of REQ-PB rows with template T05/T07/T10; grep -A14 T07 docs/analysis/field-inventory.md
checks_run.expected: All T01-T16 columns and charter fields in both files; every source value in the register or, by explicit reference, in the field inventory
checks_run.actual: 118 columns and fields checked: all present in both files. The only non-match is T05 'Fill-in', which is the form's value column, not a field. In both files: H/M/L, Support/Neutral/Resist, Decision/Tech/Data/Vendor, Risk/Assumption/Issue/Dependency, A/R, the 25/25/20/15/15 weights, the four wave horizons, the T11 SLAs ('5 working days', 'Next SteerCo / urgent route', '10 working days', 'Per release plan'), 'Red if executive decision overdue' and the T13 intervention list. In the field inventory verbatim and the register by paraphrase or reference: wave entry/exit seeds (REQ-PB-050 'seeded verbatim' → field-inventory T07 rows 4-5 list all eight); T10 per-area RAG (REQ-PB-063 input_fields paraphrase all five with source meaning); T05 financial-benefit categories and the T09 formula rows (REQ-PB-057 plus the inventory).

checks_run.procedure: For every non-template source table (modes, 6 governance roles, 6 phases, G1-G6 question and evidence, outcome hierarchy, 10 TOM dimensions, 10 canvas blocks, 10 business-case sections, 5 operating-system layers, 6 lifecycle steps, 90-day plan, roaming example and 3 traceability rows, 25 questions, 4 bands, sources table) and every list item (5 principles, 5 scope checks, 7 adoption indicators, 6 Day-90 questions, objectives, custom extensions), check each cell or item verbatim in the analysis corpus. Then read the owning requirement rows for every callout or prose block that is not verbatim.
checks_run.command: python3 deliv.py; python3 (inline) dump of mapped rows for 22 callout blocks
checks_run.expected: All table cells verbatim; callout substance (thesis, Gate-1 rule, good outcome test, TOM-not-portfolio, no double counting, escalate decisions, people-centred, escalation principle, Finance early, 90-120 min workshop) implemented as rules
checks_run.actual: Of 345 cells and items, every table cell matched verbatim. The 33 non-verbatim items are all prose or callouts, and each is carried in substance by testable rows. Examples: REQ-PB-030 four-part thesis; REQ-PB-022 no project list before G1 (409); REQ-PB-036 good outcome test; REQ-PB-040 an initiative cannot be G3 TOM evidence; REQ-PB-058 unique owner, one-time roll-up; REQ-PB-068 five agenda elements; REQ-PB-073 champions' constraints; REQ-PB-082 red-for-N-cycles creates one T16 ask; REQ-PB-055 Finance validates before G4; REQ-PB-042 90-120 minute workshop converts items to owned T04 decisions; REQ-PB-009 closure requires validated value; REQ-PB-069 adoption is an outcome.

checks_run.procedure: Check that every SOURCE-class row is REQ-PB and cites at least one existing B block, and that no REQ-PB row has another class. Count classes. Check that master-prompt additions sit in USER or ENGINEERING rows, or in REQ-PB notes under 'Master-prompt additions' and 'Interpretations'.
checks_run.command: python3 (inline) over requirements.csv and source-coverage.csv; prefreeze's check_pb_provenance.py
checks_run.actual: SOURCE 93 (= REQ-PB 93, all citing B blocks), USER 188, ENGINEERING 131; 0 problems. The REQ-PB notes separate 'Playbook (Bxxxx)', 'Master-prompt additions (§… Mxxxx)' and 'Interpretations' (e.g. REQ-PB-045: '3-7 deliverables' warns rather than blocks; REQ-PB-063: default thresholds labelled as interpretation). check_pb_provenance.py: 93 rows, 0 problems.

checks_run.procedure: Scan the analysis files, register, spec, decisions, environment, protocol, agents docs, CLAUDE.md and agent definitions for 'official PMI', 'PMI standard', 'certified', 'official/verified Mobily' and 'brand compliance'. Classify each hit as a claim or a negation. List every #0078FF mention that lacks 'provisional' within ±60 chars.
checks_run.command: grep -rn -i -E 'official PMI|PMI standard|certified|official Mobily|verified Mobily|Mobily brand compliance|compliant with PMI' …; grep -o '.{0,60}#0078FF.{0,60}'
checks_run.expected: Every hit is a negation or disclaimer; every #0078FF mention is qualified
checks_run.actual: Every hit is a disclaimer ('inspired by', 'never claim official PMI status', 'provisional text wordmark', 'no official Mobily brand compliance'). There are 12 #0078FF mentions. The 3 without 'provisional' nearby say '#0078FF is unverified' (REQ-S15-002 notes) or are contrast warnings (REQ-S15-003; frontend-ux-engineer 'never assume white text on #0078FF passes'). REQ-PB-001/002/077 require the verbatim B0004 provenance statement, custom-extension badges (B0158-B0162) and BRM 'aligns with' wording, with a scan for 'official'/'certified' claims.

checks_run.procedure: Search the register for each causal rule, then read the owning rows: RAG from trajectory and not task completion; separate delivery, adoption, validated-value and closure states; forecast and unvalidated value never counted as validated; Finance-only validation with BO accountable; a shared benefit counted once, with allocation ≤100% and the remainder shown unallocated; gates as approvals against evidence snapshots; DG0-DG7 kept separate from G1-G6; technical admins not business approvers; Unknown/Stale instead of zero.
checks_run.command: python3 (inline) regex census over requirements.csv; row dumps for REQ-S08-001, REQ-S08-013, REQ-S03-003, REQ-PB-075, REQ-PB-015, REQ-PB-021, REQ-S04-008, REQ-PB-012; grep admin docs/analysis/permissions-matrix.md
checks_run.expected: Each rule present with a testable acceptance
checks_run.actual: All present and testable. REQ-PB-063 and REQ-S07-007: 100% tasks complete with the KPI below trajectory is not Green. REQ-S03-003: setting delivery Complete leaves adoption, value and closure unchanged. REQ-S08-001: a forecast never appears in the validated total. REQ-PB-075: realized value pending Finance is excluded. REQ-PB-013: a BO calling validate gets 403, FIN succeeds. REQ-PB-045 and the RACI: BO is A. REQ-PB-058 and REQ-S20-010: a 10 million SAR benefit shared by two initiatives appears once. REQ-S08-013: 60+50 is rejected; 60+30 shows 10% unallocated. REQ-PB-015 and REQ-S12-009: the approver decides against the evidence snapshot and gates are never inferred from tasks. REQ-S04-008: product G6 changes no DG record. permissions-matrix rule 2 says technical administrators are not business approvers, and the gate-decision row gives ADM '— (never)'. 24 rows specify Unknown/Stale.

For each block, check that it has a coverage row, the disposition suits its text, the mapped requirement IDs exist and cite the block back, and the requirement title matches the block's substance.

checks_run.expected: ≥60 blocks across all sections; 0 bad mappings
checks_run.actual: 74 blocks across 22 sections, 0 bad. Every mapped requirement cites its block back, and titles match substance. Examples: M0199/M0200/M0202 T11 rows → REQ-PB-065/066; M0379 A10 benefit integrity → REQ-S20-010; M0291/M0293/M0297 provisional tokens → REQ-S15-002; M0218 'not successful solely because initiatives are complete' → REQ-PB-009, REQ-S11-006/007. The sample list is in the evidence file's final line.

Tabulate REQ-PB final gates per template against the §21 stage outputs. Read the four assigned DLV rows (status, acceptance, evidence).
checks_run.expected: 0 staging problems; template gates consistent with §21; DLV-001/002/020/032 IMPLEMENTED with concrete acceptance
checks_run.actual: 0 problems. My first pass wrongly compared increments to DG labels; the corrected P-label rerun gives 0, and the log records both. Charter, T01-T04 and the canvas are DG2 (§21 P2); business case and T05-T09 are DG3 (P3); T10-T16 are DG4 (P4); the health check, 90-day plan and roaming example are DG5; T02 and T06 span increments. The 19 DG0 rows are IMPLEMENTED. The acceptance of DLV-001 (D-001/D-002), DLV-002 (DG-only schema; G6≠DG7 text), DLV-020 (validator rejects empty or invalid rows) and DLV-032 (every block dispositioned; A24 validator test) is concrete. I confirmed the evidence in DOM25-01/02/05/07 and DOM25-11 (a gate test suite that includes A24).

checks_run.procedure: Sample Arabic glossary terms for sense and disambiguation. List the journey headings and check that they cover every phase and gate, modular entry, KPI update, Finance validation, committee workflow, BAU handover and admin publishing. Check permission-matrix rows against the B0018 roles, T11 (B0099) and T12 RACI (B0101).

checks_run.expected: Sensible MSA terms; all journeys present; matrix consistent with source roles, T11 and RACI; ADM not a business approver
checks_run.actual: The terms are sensible, and ambiguity is handled explicitly: 'مالك الأعمال' is replaced by 'المالك التشغيلي للأعمال', 'المعالجة' by 'خطة الاستدراك والمعالجة', and stage gate is 'بوابة المرحلة' with a note that it is not a DG. Journeys J2.1-J2.6 cover the six phases and G1-G6, plus J3 modular entry, J4 KPI update, J5 Finance validation, J6 committee, J7 BAU handover and J8 admin publishing. In the matrix, Charter shows SP Ap (A), TL C/U/S (R), BO Rv (C), FIN Rv (C); Business case shows SP Ap and FIN U Va (R); T11 Go-live/scale shows BO Ap and initiative owner recommends; gate decision is ADM '— (never)'. Assumptions are labelled for business confirmation.

checks_run.procedure: Run the full gate suite with the CI invocation, then the two D-041-named tests. As a mutation test in a second disposable clone, delete the restored anchor-1 lines (round.source_commit ancestry) from checkClosure and confirm that the 'F-DG0-110 / F-DG0-204' test fails, then restore them and confirm it passes. This covers the 'fix after freeze' case anchor 1 alone must catch; the fixture's round, run and gate commits are identical, so a separate post-freeze/pre-run ordering reduces to the same isAncestor(fix, round.source_commit) predicate.
checks_run.command: node --test tools/gates/tests/*.test.mjs; node --test --test-name-pattern='F-DG0-110 / F-DG0-204|D-039/D-040' tools/gates/tests/validator.test.mjs; (mutant) same pattern after removing the 2 anchor-1 lines
checks_run.environment: --no-local clones at 2386a0f in $TMPDIR (the mutant clone was removed afterwards); node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: 62/62 pass; both named tests pass; the mutant fails with a missing 'is not in the verified round-2 candidate'
checks_run.actual: 62 tests, 62 pass, 0 fail (exit 0), matching D-041's 'gate suite 62 pass'. Both named tests pass; 'D-039/D-040 …' covers the forged self-declared-absent round (anchor 2). The mutant fails with 'expected an error matching /is not in the verified round-2 candidate/' (exit 1), and the unmutated code passes (exit 0), so anchor 1 is enforced and test-guarded. An earlier `node --test tools/gates/tests/` failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND because Node 22 does not accept a bare directory there; that was my invocation error, not a test failure, and the log records it.

checks_run.procedure: Clone the real repository --no-local into $TMPDIR, draft a schema-valid APPROVED DG0 gate on the frozen candidate, and run validateGate. Classify every error into round-completion buckets, the three D-041 closure-anchor buckets, pruned-head, record-less and dropped. Check that every findings.json fix_revision is present. Remove the clone.
checks_run.environment: Fresh --no-local clone of HEAD e84c393 (223 commits, complete history) in $TMPDIR; node v22.22.2
checks_run.expected: 0 errors in every closure-anchor and history bucket; the remaining errors are only round-completion items
checks_run.actual: 0 errors for anchor 1 (frozen round candidate), anchor 2 (verifying-run head) and anchor 3 (gate candidate); 0 pruned-head, 0 record-less, 0 dropped. findings.json has 117 findings, 115 with a fix_revision, 0 of them absent. There are 54 errors, all round-completion items, which I classified by hand in the log: 8 for missing round-25 records or state REVIEWING; 40 for DG0-final requirements not yet listed by round-25 records; 1 synthetic-gate final_gate_ids artefact; 1 for F-DG0-168 awaiting its round-25 verification; 6 for F-DG0-147/149 awaiting auditor concurrence.

checks_run.command: git clone -q --no-local /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/pf && git checkout 2386a0f && bash tools/gates/prefreeze.sh DG0
checks_run.environment: Fresh --no-local clone at 2386a0f (shallow=false) in $TMPDIR; node v22.22.2; python3
checks_run.expected: All pre-freeze checks PASS; working-tree candidate equals the frozen ID
checks_run.actual: 11/11 PASS (exit 0): extraction reproducible; gate validator and guard tests; runner metadata and settings tests; register rules DG0; register equals the merge of parts; pipeline state; acceptance map; README counts; PB provenance (93 rows, 0 problems); test references (0 problems); working-tree candidate sha256:b77a1c63…cbab. checks_run.procedure: Confirm that the D-041 decision row makes no business, operating-logic or source-provenance claim, and check its factual claims against the round-24 records (verdicts, findings, verifications, gate record). Check D-039's F-DG0-013 correction and its gc claim: objects 450c756 and cb76260 must be absent from both the main repository and a --no-local clone.
checks_run.command: node over reviews/DG0/round-24/*.json and sidecars; ls docs/delivery/gates; grep D-039/D-041 docs/delivery/decisions.md; git cat-file -t 450c756 / cb76260 (main and clone)
checks_run.environment: --no-local clone at 2386a0f and the main repository
checks_run.expected: D-041 contains no domain claims; its round-24 facts are accurate; both objects are absent
checks_run.actual: D-041 has 0 hits for PMI, Mobily, G1-G6, business approval, Finance or validated value; it describes delivery tooling only. Its facts are accurate. Round-24 verdicts were domain PASS [], qa PASS [], code-security PASS [F-DG0-168 (Low, mandatory_violation=false)]. The verifications were F-DG0-014 (domain), F-DG0-166/167 (code-security) and F-DG0-249 (qa), all CLOSED_VERIFIED. No gate record exists, so 'none wrongly approved a gate' holds. D-039's F-DG0-013 text correctly says the orphan was an unreachable object copied by local-path clones, removed by reflog expiry and gc, and that --no-local is prescribed. `git cat-file -t` fails for 450c756 and cb76260 in both the main repository and the clone.

summary: PASS with no findings. The P0 specification is faithful to playbook v1.0: complete extraction, all 165 blocks dispositioned, T01-T16 columns and value lists preserved, every first-class deliverable specified, operating-logic semantics testable, provenance honest, and the stage plan consistent with §21. The D-041 closure change is correct, test-guarded (mutation-tested) and clean on the complete history; decisions.md D-041/D-039 make no domain claims and their facts check out. All my earlier findings (F-DG0-001…014) were already CLOSED_VERIFIED, so nothing was left to re-verify.
